checks.detail: Required top-level keys present; fields keys are a subset of the 9 allowed keys; every field carries value/status/evidence_refs/confidence/reason_summary with enum-valid status and confidence.
experiment_id/run_id/action_id equal EXP-PROC-7X9D-01/6WUM1/patch-001 and candidate_binding run_id/action_id match.
All evidence_refs across fields resolve to pack source_ids (SEED-01, S001, S006-S011, S012-S018, S021 as used).
No field cites S019 (FETCH_FAILED) or any non-pack source.
All 8 PROPOSED fields (fix_type, strategy, target_version, artifact_source, source_identifier, command, validation_command, notes) carry non-empty evidence_refs.
No ABSTAINED fields present; build_system is NOT_APPLICABLE with null value and empty refs.
Pack gates command=SUPPORTED and validation_command=SUPPORTED, so PROPOSED command text is permitted; no INSUFFICIENT gate is violated and no ABSTAINED field carries text.

No replacement_target, checksum, trusted, source_authority, source_type, human_confirmed_fields, major_version_approved, execution_target, disposition, disposition_reason, readiness, or remediation_verified fields present.
validation proposal_sha256 equals sha256 of the frozen agent_proposal.json bytes; embedded proposal field value recorded separately with method note.

sha_method: sha256 over the exact frozen agent_proposal.json file bytes; the embedded proposal_sha256 field is inherently one write iteration stale (self-hash), so the recomputable file digest is anchored here.
validation_scope: mechanical only: JSON and schema conformance, binding, pack SHA match, evidence-ref resolution, citation coverage, gate compliance, forbidden-field absence, digest recording. No semantic self-review.
